violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Benefits (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(A))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operational policy did not include information related to the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.   The operation corrected at inspection.

finding_variants.text: The operational policy did not include information related to the promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity.   The operation corrected at inspection.
The benefits of physical activity are not included in the parent handbook. The duration of active play and criteria for determining extreme weather conditions  are also not addressed.
The operational policy did not contain a section explaining the benefits of physical activity and outdoor play.
The operation did not have the required information for promtion indoor and outdoor play.
The operation did not have in their operational policy on the benefits of physical activity .
In review of the operational policies/parent handbook the benefits of outdoor play were not available for review.

Written Operational Policies - Benefits: The operational policies reviewed were missing the following information:    Promotion of indoor and outdoor physical activity that is consistent with Subchapter F of this chapter (relating to Developmental Activities) your policies must include:    (A) The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;  (B) The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor;  (C) The type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation;  (D) Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place;  (E) The recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physicalactivities; and  (F) A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
